shared_elements: carved stone surface with low-relief/incised motifs
paired motifs arranged symmetrically about a vertical axis
horizontal band(s) crossing the lower part of the surface
suggestion of a human or humanoid form
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow carved motifs organised symmetrically about a central vertical axis, and both include ring/disc forms above a horizontal banded zone (an incised text-like band in A, belt-like grooves in B). Otherwise they are fundamentally unlike: A is a flat, wide slab with dense, fine, controlled incision depicting figures and a central plant, while B is a massive three-dimensional monolith in coarse weathered stone with only a few sparse, blunt reliefs.
